taxonomic_note: Legacy Master Plant Pool name Lesquerella sessilis normalized to current accepted Physaria sessilis.
look_here_first: Yellow-flowered bladderpod whose upper leaves are notably sessile, helping separate it from more obviously petiolate relatives.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Hays-local legacy source; Kew and ITIS accept Physaria sessilis and list Lesquerella sessilis as synonym.
project_inclusion.range_guardrail: Installed for active visual learning; broader exact-county reconciliation deferred.

morphology_keys.family_pattern: Brassicaceae bladderpod group: 4-petaled yellow flowers, stellate hairs common, and inflated silicles/capsules; habit, hair density, pedicel posture, and fruit shape are important for ID.
best_field_traits: upper leaves sessile or nearly so
morphology_keys.comparison_training: The leaf attachment is the first-look cue: sessilis = sessile. Use that before diving into fruit details.
